title: ZnS QDs and Nanomaterials Research
summary: This cluster revolves around the research on ZnS QDs (quantum dots) and their interactions with various organisms and chemicals. ZnS QDs are manufactured by IMEM-CNR and characterized using dynamic light scattering. They are exposed to yeast strains and wild-type, inducing ROS and cell death. Additionally, ZnS QDs cause hypersensitivity in pos5Δ and modulate Mitochondrion. Nanomaterials research, published by several authors, is also present in this cluster. The interactions between ZnS QDs and other chemicals, such as ZnSO4 and ROS, are also explored.
